title: Mass-Flow Invariance of $Q$-Cohomology in BMN Matrix Quantum Mechanics
summary: We study the dependence of the dynamical supercharges of BMN matrix quantum mechanics on the mass parameter $μ$. Taking the $μ$-derivative at fixed canonical matrix variables, we show that the sixteen-component supercharge evolves by the adjoint action of a Hermitian quadratic bosonic operator $\mathcal{K}$, together with the spinor-space factor $iγ^{123}$. After projection to a $γ^{123}$-eigenspace, this flow integrates to a finite similarity transformation.
